item.description: Author Sarah Helm, married to Jonathan Powell, wrote to back novelist Sally Rooney’s support of proscribed direct action group The UK’s national security adviser, Jonathan Powell, is under pressure to distance himself from a comment made by his wife, the award-winning writer Sarah Helm , in support of Palestine Action. The post was made in defence of the critically acclaimed Irish novelist Sally Rooney, who said she had been forced to pull her books from shelves in the UK after pledging proceeds from their sales to Palestine Action. item.title: Colonos israelíes atacan brutalmente la aldea de Abu Falah y agreden a una fotógrafa de EE. UU.
item.description: Heidi Levine, fotógrafa del 'The Washington Post', y al menos un palestino están hospitalizados debido al brutal ataque coordinado por decenas de colonos israelíes, durante la recogida de aceituna en el pueblo de Abu Falah, cerca de Ramala. Levine estaba claramente identificada como prensa con chaleco y casco, pero esto, en Cisjordania, desde hace varios años, no es suficiente para evitar ataques a periodistas. La fotógrafa fue golpeada en varias tandas unas 50 veces, además de que le quitaron su pasaporte, el teléfono y otros elementos. Nuestra corresponsal, Janira Gómez Muñoz, nos amplió… Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: Sally Rooney's books no longer sold in UK over support for banned pro-Palestinian group
item.description: Irish novelist Sally ⁠Rooney's books will ​no longer be sold in Britain over her plans to use her royalties ​to support Palestine Action, a pro-Palestinian group banned as a terrorist organisation, Rooney and her publisher said on Wednesday. The bestselling author, known for novels including "Normal People" and "Conversations with ​Friends", has ‌been a vocal supporter of Palestine Action, including after ⁠it was proscribed by the British government under terrorism laws last year. Publicado también por: NPR - World. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Los hutíes intensifican su ofensiva y bombardean el palacio presidencial de Yemen
item.description: Los rebeldes hutíes no cesan su ofensiva contra el Gobierno de Yemen y sus aliados en la región. Su último golpe ha sido un ataque con misiles contra el palacio presidencial yemení en la ciudad portuaria de Adén, al sur del país. El impacto dejó cinco muertos y, al menos, 16 heridos.Los hutíes, una guerrilla chií aliada de Irán, llevan varias semanas de ofensiva contra las tropas del Ejército regular de Yemen y también contra su vecino, Arabia Saudí. Aunque esta última embestida se ha saldado con la vida de varios funcionarios que protegían la zona y algunos civiles, fuentes gubernamentales… Fuente: ABC España - Internacional.

item.title: ‘Tough to watch, impossible to ignore’: what the reviewers say about NAZA documentary
item.description: Film interviewing military insiders about mass killing of civilians in Gaza receives widespread praise around the world Critics around the world have hailed the award-winning documentary NAZA as a “brilliant and harrowing” film that is “impossible to ignore”. NAZA, which is produced by the Guardian and details Israel’s mass killing of civilians in Gaza, was released in UK cinemas this week and will be shown in more than 50 countries. As well as its global cinema releases, NAZA will be available free on the Guardian’s website from late November. Continue reading... Fuente: The Guardian - World.
